llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Vercel integration that can affect live projects, domains, deployments, and environment variables, but its sensitive access is purpose-aligned and clearly documented.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is managing Vercel resources through Maton-managed OAuth, and the documented capabilities match that purpose, including projects, deployments, domains, teams, and environment variables.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill lists specific supported endpoints and explicitly requires user approval before create, update, or delete operations; the scope is powerful but disclosed and user-directed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with API examples only; no install scripts, executable files, dependencies, or hidden setup behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access, a MATON_API_KEY, and Maton-brokered Vercel OAuth are proportionate for the integration, but users should understand that account and project data flows through Maton.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistent OAuth connections through Maton are disclosed, connection selection and deletion are documented, and there is no evidence of local persistence or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you trust Maton to broker access to your Vercel account. Use the narrowest practical Vercel connection, specify the intended connection when multiple accounts exist, and approve write actions only after checking the exact project, deployment, domain, team, or environment variable being changed.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, which is consistent with the artifact review showing disclosed, purpose-aligned Vercel API access.
[static_scan] expected: The static scan was clean, and the workspace contained only SKILL.md plus metadata and scanner reports.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was pending, so it was not treated as a negative signal.
